'''Caz Ocean''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lazerian IV]]. It was located predominantly in the planet's eastern hemisphere to the west of the continent [[Doxet]] and to the east of the continent [[Laz]], and it extended as far as both poles of the planet. Alongside [[Dox Ocean]] opposite of it, it formed the [[Water/Legends|waters]] that the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibious]] [[Akwin]] [[Species/Legends|species]] knew as "[[Father Ocean]]." The [[City/Legends|city]] [[Dorynn]] and [[City-state/Legends|city-state]] [[Doxeti]], which were on Laz and Doxet, respectively, bordered the coastal waters of Caz Ocean.<ref name="TSoK" />

Both [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] were collectively home to an abundance of marine life, including numerous aquatic creatures of which some were small, [[Coral/Legends|corals]], and a large variety of aquatic [[Plant/Legends|plants]]. Both the Akwin and the native [[Human/Legends|Human]] population, the [[Lazerian (people)|Lazerians]], relied on the marine life for [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], with the latter partaking in [[Fishing/Legends|fishing]]. They were also rich in [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] that blocked [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] scans, which hid the Akwin that resided in various city-states on the ocean floor.<ref name="TSoK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Caz Ocean was created by [[John Terra]] and introduced in [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']], a [[1993]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TSoK" />
